verdict.rationale: LangSmith is an observability and evaluation platform, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official, first-party LangSmith MCP server repository (langchain-ai/langsmith-mcp-server) that agents can connect to. The evidence is a single existence mention with no detail on what the server exposes, so depth is thin. missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools and capabilities (e.g., trace, dataset, or prompt access), setup and auth instructions, hosted endpoint details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity.
